recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If BR&R wants the base resource to make representation.format mandatory, handle that as a new explicit Jira/change proposal rather than silently changing the R5-published optional cardinality during reconciliation.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive BR&R R5 change request asking for a new SubstanceDefinition.structure.representation.format element to capture chemical structure representation format data, described as a CodeableConcept with draft cardinality 1..1.
initial_application: Commit 3885120c62 added SubstanceDefinition.structure.representation.format to the then-current SubstanceDefinition spreadsheet as CodeableConcept 0..1. Commit 6e7cd064f3 applied a similar format concept to the historical SubstancePolymer spreadsheet, but SubstancePolymer is not in the current build. Later source rework carried the SubstanceDefinition element into source/substancedefinition/structuredefinition-SubstanceDefinition.xml.
additional_context: SubstanceDefinition is active and approved in source/fhir.ini. Current source defines representation.format as a 0..1 CodeableConcept bound to ValueSet/substance-representation-format, and the current code system/value set contain the requested representation formats. The R5 published profile also reports min 0 and max 1. Community searches found no direct conflicting decision; a later FHIR-55056 no-change terminology issue does not require a source or cardinality change.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. No source edit was made because the element and terminology are already present, and changing the current base cardinality to 1..1 would be a substantive conformance change without evidence of a later BR&R decision overriding the applied and published 0..1 model.
